Rejected: a generic table/lambda parser (larger, easier to subtly change validation behavior).
nodes.norm_label: principle: split ini parser by section

nodes.label: Decision: Stage Native Controller Controls Behind Probes
nodes.rationale: Keep the keyboard/mouse bridge available for headset testing while migrating controller actions toward KEX-native command/control paths in stages; fix right-stick jump/crouch sensitivity immediately with separate vertical thresholds rather than reusing the movement deadzone. Rejected: treating analog sticks as only digital keypress generators, or switching every control to unproven native calls at once.
nodes.norm_label: decision: stage native controller controls behind probes

nodes.label: Decision: Test Direct-Yaw Snap Turns
nodes.rationale: Add snap_turn_direct_yaw and set the active test INI true, preserving the mouse-accumulator snap path as immediate revert, since live snap logs with the accumulator path still showed unstable yaw scale/sign and transient KEX pitch spikes; a discrete VR snap should be a yaw-only body/camera step, not a mouse-look impulse.
nodes.norm_label: decision: test direct-yaw snap turns

nodes.label: Decision: Filter Low World Ray-Trace Hits
nodes.rationale: In world_aim_mode=ray_trace, accept direct segment-trace targets only when the hit object id is at least a configurable minimum (default 256); otherwise leave selection to KEX's native candidate picker, since Ghidra shows the native picker scores usable candidates and uses segment trace as LOS, not final selection. Rejected: treating every first collision hit as the frob target, or hard-coding known floor/wall ids.
nodes.norm_label: decision: filter low world ray-trace hits

nodes.label: Decision: Add Angular Pitch Bias for Selection Hand
nodes.rationale: Add aim_pitch_bias_degrees applied to the selection-hand head-local ray before both flat cursor projection and ray_trace, since direct aligned aim missed a wall switch but pitching the controller down ~20 degrees selected it, matching a ~20-degree offset seen elsewhere in camera/picker calibration (an angular frame mismatch, not a target-class problem).
nodes.norm_label: decision: add angular pitch bias for selection hand

nodes.label: Decision: Prioritize Resolved Weapon Fire Handler Over Launch-Flag Tuning
nodes.rationale: Treat FUN_1403eedd0/0x3EEDD0 as the best current pistol/hitscan aim-takeover candidate after read-only x64dbg enumeration of the live action table resolved a vcall to that RVA; Ghidra shows it performs per-weapon shot setup with two flagged traces, a cleaner aim sink than previously investigated projectile movement/launch callers. Rejected: continuing to tune FUN_14051ee80 launch flags, or globally overriding trace/movement calls without filtering.
nodes.norm_label: decision: prioritize resolved weapon fire handler over launch-flag tuning

nodes.label: Decision: Start Weapon Model Takeover From Object Attachment Evidence
nodes.rationale: For the later visible weapon/hand phase, prioritize CreatureWeaponAttachWeapon, WeaponOffset, PlyrArm, and filtered creature attachment updates before any render-draw or broad transform patch, based on Ghidra evidence for FUN_1403f3090/FUN_1401b6310/FUN_140519380/FUN_1403f25c0 and live-confirmed prologues/property globals. Rejected: editing D3D weapon draws before proving the in-engine object/attachment path.
nodes.norm_label: decision: start weapon model takeover from object attachment evidence

nodes.label: Principle: Stage Future Weapon Aim/Model Options as Off-by-Default Probes
nodes.rationale: Add disabled-by-default [weapon] gates for the resolved fire handler, WeaponOffset, PlyrArm motion, and creature attachment callback, keeping every new path log-only, since the creature-attachment route may describe NPC/mutant equipment rather than the player viewmodel and should be treated as suspicious until proven.
nodes.norm_label: principle: stage future weapon aim/model options as off-by-default probes

nodes.label: Decision: Add Pitch-First Late RenderView Residual as Comfort Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Keep the one-camera KEX baseline default, add render_view_late_residual as an opt-in visual-only diagnostic with pitch-only defaults, since full render_view_authoritative=true creates a second camera authority that previously complicated selection/culling. Rejected: returning display-authoritative mode to default, or increasing pitch-servo aggression as the first comfort fix.
nodes.norm_label: decision: add pitch-first late renderview residual as comfort diagnostic

nodes.label: Decision: Use KEX Hover Candidates as the Next Left-Hand World-Selection Bridge
nodes.rationale: Add world_candidate_scoring, reusing the existing guarded hover-candidate hook to reassert direct accepted high-object ray hits after KEX native hover scoring, and force the nearest KEX hover candidate near the controller ray, since raw trace is still collision-first for small objects while native screen-space selection is HMD-dependent and flickery. Rejected: more aim_flat_offset_y tuning, flipping the pitch bias negative, or writing a new unguarded object enumeration path.
nodes.norm_label: decision: use kex hover candidates as the next left-hand world-selection bridge

nodes.label: Decision: Separate Snap-Turn Pixel Gain From HMD Yaw Gain
nodes.rationale: Added snap_turn_pixels_per_degree (0.5) after a requested 20-degree snap injected as 20 yaw pixels produced ~40 degrees of KEX yaw on the next tick, proving HMD yaw-delta gain and controller snap-turn gain are not the same calibration.
nodes.norm_label: decision: separate snap-turn pixel gain from hmd yaw gain

nodes.label: Decision: First Comfort Fix Is Pitch-Servo Deadzone, Not Late Residual
nodes.rationale: Lowered pitch_servo_deadzone_degrees from 0.75 to 0.15 and kept render_view_late_residual=false for left-hand selection tests, since the comfort log showed servoPx=0 through slow pitch movement until the old deadzone was crossed, matching perceived stepping.
nodes.norm_label: decision: first comfort fix is pitch-servo deadzone, not late residual

nodes.label: Principle: Borrow VR Mod Architecture, Not Broad Camera Authority
nodes.rationale: Use other VR mods (JKXR, CSVR, GTFO_VR_Plugin, RoR2VRMod, BendyVR) as architecture references for central pose/ray state and narrow semantic consumers; keep separate UI, world-selection, weapon-aim, and weapon-model paths fed from shared converted pose data. Rejected: returning to a broad display-authoritative camera path, fixing every domain with more flat cursor offsets, or globally patching all segment traces/model transforms.
nodes.norm_label: principle: borrow vr mod architecture, not broad camera authority

nodes.label: Decision (Superseded): Park Snap-Turn and Test Smooth Analog Direct Yaw
nodes.rationale: Multiple headset tests still showed snap-turn wrong-direction/jerky/flash-frame prone; switched the active diagnostic to turn_mode=smooth with snap_turn_direct_yaw=true and small joystick-scaled object-direct KEX yaw writes. Superseded by testing smooth analog through KEX's normal pre-turn mouse accumulator instead.
nodes.norm_label: decision (superseded): park snap-turn and test smooth analog direct yaw

nodes.label: Decision: Make vr.world_scale the Single Metres-to-KEX Conversion
nodes.rationale: Route HMD 6DOF translation, controller-origin world rays, pick-camera probe offsets, world-candidate scoring radii, and stereo physical IPD through a single world_scale, since the previous code had two incompatible unit systems (position_scale for HMD/controller, raw eye_separation for stereo), explaining why leaning, weapon scale, and eye separation could each feel individually tuned but disagree.
nodes.norm_label: decision: make vr.world_scale the single metres-to-kex conversion

nodes.label: Decision: Build the v0.6 DLL-to-Squirrel Weapon Pose Bridge
nodes.rationale: Add model_pose_bridge publishing one raw ss2vr_aim config string for the Squirrel weapon-handoff probe, model-only for the first pass (rotation on, translation off, v0.5 manual offsets as fallback), since v0.5 confirmed the CameraObj control surface and one raw string avoids spamming multiple console set commands per frame. The native bridge calls the guarded FUN_1408d2c20 setter through a POD-only SEH wrapper, failing closed only on an actual call exception.
nodes.norm_label: decision: build the v0.6 dll-to-squirrel weapon pose bridge

nodes.label: Decision (Confirmed Live): v0.6 Weapon Rotation
nodes.rationale: Treat the DLL-to-Squirrel pose bridge as validated for visible weapon rotation per user report ('the gun rotates live'); translation, rig-level muzzle/joint pinning, and projectile direction remain separate follow-up tests rather than assumed-solved.
nodes.norm_label: decision (confirmed live): v0.6 weapon rotation

nodes.label: Decision: Build v0.7/v0.8 Squirrel Interaction and Options-Menu Probe
nodes.rationale: Package a probe that keeps the confirmed weapon CameraObj bridge and adds two opt-in spikes: Squirrel-driven ss2vr_sel selection-hand world ray, and a small options.rml override with two SS2VR cvar sliders, testing both contracts without new RVA hooks. Result: loose-file menu/options.rml replacement works, but the .kpf menu override route and arbitrary custom ss2vr_* cvar binding through the vanilla Options data model were both falsified live; the Options-RML probe was removed from the handoff KPF afterward.
nodes.norm_label: decision: build v0.7/v0.8 squirrel interaction and options-menu probe

nodes.label: Decision: Use Squirrel Scale and Rigid Melee Pose Before Bone IK
nodes.rationale: Add a Squirrel-level ss2vr_weapon_scale control for the viewmodel object's Scale property before retuning stereo/world scale, and prototype rigid controller-driven PlyrArm/wrench reposition first, since Squirrel exposes only bone/joint reads and limited JointPos translation, not general bone rotations. Rejected: retuning world_scale/stereo IPD to hide oversized weapons, or starting with native skeleton memory writes before Squirrel-level rigid pose is tested.
nodes.norm_label: decision: use squirrel scale and rigid melee pose before bone ik

nodes.label: Decision: Build v0.9 Scale, Rigid Melee, and Opt-In Melee Gesture Driver
nodes.rationale: Implement ss2vr_weapon_scale (default 1.0, baseline-safe) in the confirmed Squirrel handler, rigid wrench/arm visual follow as Squirrel-only default-off, and a native melee gesture driver in the DLL as default-off reusing the confirmed native fire action, since the fire bridge is the safest way to test hold/release charge/release before any custom collision path. No bone IK or new RVA hooks added; no native melee-equipped gate yet, so it must remain opt-in.
nodes.norm_label: decision: build v0.9 scale, rigid melee, and opt-in melee gesture driver

nodes.label: Decision: Add Default-Off OpenXR Selection Bracket Prototype
nodes.rationale: Add a default-off DLL-side fixed billboard corner bracket in the OpenXR reticle layer rather than jumping to Squirrel-fed PhysDims world boxes or native bracket suppression, since Squirrel can supply gameplay data but cannot draw into the headset 3D scene and the existing selection_marker pipeline already publishes selected-object direction.
nodes.norm_label: decision: add default-off openxr selection bracket prototype

nodes.label: Decision: Promote Weapon Basis Mode 1 and Harden Squirrel Interaction Trigger Data
nodes.rationale: Treat ss2vr_weapon_pose_translation_mode=1 as canonical CameraObj basis (forward<-cl.y, left<-cl.x, up<-cl.z) after pose logs identified the basis mismatch directly; extend ss2vr_sel to triggerClick/triggerDown so the one-frame trigger edge isn't lost; keep menu nav flagged not-yet-functional; treat melee empty-space hit sounds as an expected native-aim limitation rather than a chasing target.
nodes.norm_label: decision: promote weapon basis mode 1 and harden squirrel interaction trigger data

nodes.label: Decision: v1.2 Pose/Input Response — Signs, Body-Decoupled Wrench, Secondary Click
nodes.rationale: Turn weapon pose translation on by default and flip default CameraObj lateral/bank signs after testing showed forward/back was useful but left/right and roll were inverted; stop adding Camera.GetFacing() to rigid wrench orientation by default (it caused a figure-eight across body yaw) and derive heading/pitch from the published controller world ray instead; add a right-hand inventory UI route and secondary-button context action.
nodes.norm_label: decision: v1.2 pose/input response — signs, body-decoupled wrench, secondary click

nodes.label: Decision: v1.3 Correction — Old-Path Left-Interaction Filter
nodes.rationale: Move the immediate noisy-target filter to the older C++ world_candidate_scoring path and add world_candidate_require_native_stage=true (scored candidates forced only when KEX's own post-callback staging/frob globals also name the candidate), since the filter was intended for the older left-hand interaction, not the unproven Squirrel spike, which C++ still lacks native FrobInfo/name/archetype access to classify precisely.
nodes.norm_label: decision: v1.3 correction — old-path left-interaction filter

nodes.label: Decision: v1.4 Weapon/Wrench Pose Correction
nodes.rationale: Set CameraObj rotation lock subprops from default-on lock_heading/pitch/bank cvars and replace the default wrench world-absolute orientation with orientation_mode=3 (player-heading-relative, swizzled, pulled back from controller origin), since wrench axes were reported crossed (roll drives pitch, pitch drives roll) and the arm needed to rotate with player heading instead of facing a fixed world direction.
nodes.norm_label: decision: v1.4 weapon/wrench pose correction

nodes.label: Decision: Add SS2VR-Owned VR Action Panel Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Implement a default-off [vr_action_panel] OpenXR popup using existing Touch A/B actions rather than binding more custom cvars into the vanilla RmlUi Options data model, since arbitrary custom cvar binding was already falsified live; while open, right-trigger fire is suppressed and normal routing is skipped so the test is modal and bounded, and console command strings are parsed/logged but not executed yet.
nodes.norm_label: decision: add ss2vr-owned vr action panel diagnostic

nodes.label: Decision: v1.5 Restore Player-Relative Weapon Yaw
nodes.rationale: Reverted v1.4's default-on CameraObj rotation locks for the pistol path after user testing falsified the lock-default hypothesis (the pistol stayed facing one world direction regardless of player facing); locks remain available as diagnostics, default 0, so controller pose layers on top of normal player-relative CameraObj composition.
nodes.norm_label: decision: v1.5 restore player-relative weapon yaw

nodes.label: Decision: Start VR-Clean Weapon Mesh Side Quest
nodes.rationale: Stage AE upgraded first-person weapon meshes and hand/arm textures for safe editing, treating clean VR meshes as the preferred fix for forearms/floating geometry visible in room-scale VR, since transform fixes alone cannot reliably hide forearms while preserving hand/weapon/muzzle alignment and the Squirrel CameraObj viewmodel path is already confirmed live.
nodes.norm_label: decision: start vr-clean weapon mesh side quest

nodes.label: Decision: v1.6 Implement Squirrel Projectile Aim Stage A
nodes.rationale: Implement the first functional weapon-aim takeover by patching NDShootTriggerScript.OnCreate, gated behind ss2vr_weapon_vr/ss2vr_weapon_aim and default off, prioritizing direction authority over skill/spread polish, since runtime evidence showed pistol/laser paths are projectile-based and prior native trace/launch sinks were either not hit or downstream. ss2vr_aim already publishes right-hand world origin/direction into Squirrel every frame.
nodes.norm_label: decision: v1.6 implement squirrel projectile aim stage a

nodes.label: Decision: v1.7 Replace Sealed Class Patch With Parallel Projectile Script
nodes.rationale: Directly assigning NDShootTriggerScript.OnCreate failed at runtime with 'trying to set class'; use a parallel SS2VRShootAimScript extends SqRootScript attached via ND.Archetype(...AddScript(...)), the same mechanism base weapon_handler.nut uses, keeping the base script installed and only redirecting player-fired projectiles.
nodes.norm_label: decision: v1.7 replace sealed class patch with parallel projectile script

nodes.label: Decision: Use Additive Viewmodels for Left-Hand/Grab Visuals
nodes.rationale: Nightdive's viewmodel system supports multiple simultaneous viewmodels per a developer confirmation; prefer an additive second hand viewmodel for left-hand presence/grab visuals driven through the same CameraObj pose bridge pattern as the right weapon, keeping gameplay interaction/frob ownership separate. This validates the CameraObj workaround as reusable rather than a one-off weapon hack and reduces pressure to solve full skeleton/IK immediately.
nodes.norm_label: decision: use additive viewmodels for left-hand/grab visuals

nodes.label: Decision: Start VR Tonal Effects as an OpenXR Layer
nodes.rationale: Implement scanline/static/damage/comms visual effects as a head-locked OpenXR composition quad layer submitted after scene projection but before UI/reticle/action-panel/pointer layers, with a manual F5 hotkey cycle for tuning before binding to damage/comms events, since this is much lower risk than a D3D11 post-process or RenderView modification.
nodes.norm_label: decision: start vr tonal effects as an openxr layer

nodes.label: Decision: Probe Native Dark Stereo Before Attempting D3D11 Replay
nodes.rationale: Test old Dark toggle_stereo_view/set_stereo_mirror as the next same-frame dual-eye candidate before starting a low-level D3D11 replay implementation, since static RE found a two-pass eye loop with eye-specific RenderView uploads. Result: forcing the byte produced no visual change; the path was parked as inert unless a future D3D11 capture proves the function active.
nodes.norm_label: decision: probe native dark stereo before attempting d3d11 replay

nodes.label: Decision: Compensate Only the Weapon Viewmodel Pose for HMD 6DOF
nodes.rationale: Keep projectile aim world-space data raw, but compensate the Squirrel CameraObj cl* pose for HMD positional delta, since the OpenXR bridge reports the controller relative to the live HMD while RenderView also applies HMD 6DOF translation, making the model appear to slide when the user moves their head with a stationary controller. Compensating the w* aim fields would corrupt right-hand aim, so only the visual pose is compensated.
nodes.norm_label: decision: compensate only the weapon viewmodel pose for hmd 6dof

nodes.label: Decision: Use Direct LGMD Face-Compaction for First 3ds Max Edited-Mesh Tier
nodes.rationale: Implement the first edited-mesh exporter (Funk Mesh) as a direct LGMD writer instead of continuing through .3ds -> N3ds2e -> BSP, since the BSP path repeatedly produced duplicate points/sliver polygons and modal assertions on AE high-poly viewmodels. Scope narrowly: preserve original vertex table length, allow moved vertices, allow deletion of complete original faces only; reject added faces, vertex deletion, and partial n-gon deletion until a full mesh compiler exists.
nodes.norm_label: decision: use direct lgmd face-compaction for first 3ds max edited-mesh tier

nodes.label: Decision (Confirmed Live): Funk Mesh Forearm Trim
nodes.rationale: Treat Funk Mesh v0.4.0-nodefix as the active path for VR-clean weapon mesh surgery limited to moved vertices plus complete-face deletion, after the user confirmed the node-fixed package loads in AE with deleted polygons rendering correctly and all pistol animations preserved. Prior failure modes (header face count, split/call BSP child-node offset remap, modinfo.json requirements) are understood and fixed.
nodes.norm_label: decision (confirmed live): funk mesh forearm trim

nodes.label: Decision: Suppress Native Offhand Viewmodel Animation Through Squirrel JointPos
nodes.rationale: Do not make the Max exporter responsible for disabling native offhand animation; use the existing late Squirrel weapon handler to force selected JointPos channels after AE's native OnFrameUpdate, since AE weapon animations are Squirrel PointRig keyframes writing JointPos every frame and this can be toggled live without replacing libs/viewmodel.nut. v1.9 defaults (freezing Joint 3, forcing Joint 2) were live-falsified as too aggressive; v1.10 leaves Joint 2 native and only parks Joint 3 at neutral.
nodes.norm_label: decision: suppress native offhand viewmodel animation through squirrel jointpos

nodes.label: Decision: Include an Existing-Save Patcher in Final SS2VR Tooling
nodes.rationale: Add a small offline save patcher so users can add the VR mod package to an existing AE save without starting a new game; default behavior writes a patched copy and leaves the source save untouched, with in-place mode allowed only behind an explicit --in-place flag that creates a timestamped backup first.
nodes.norm_label: decision: include an existing-save patcher in final ss2vr tooling

nodes.label: Use Direct LGMD Face-Compaction for First 3ds Max Edited-Mesh Tier
nodes.rationale: Direct LGMD writing avoids the BSP path's duplicate-point/sliver-polygon failures; the tier is scoped to preserve original vertices while only allowing whole-face deletion until a full mesh compiler exists.
nodes.norm_label: use direct lgmd face-compaction for first 3ds max edited-mesh tier

nodes.label: Funk Mesh Forearm Trim Confirmed Live in AE
nodes.rationale: Funk Mesh v0.4.0-nodefix became the active path once forearm-trim edits loaded and rendered in AE with animations intact, fixing header face-count and BSP node-offset remap bugs.
nodes.norm_label: funk mesh forearm trim confirmed live in ae

nodes.label: Suppress Native Offhand Viewmodel Animation via Squirrel JointPos
nodes.rationale: Rather than modifying the Max exporter, a Squirrel handler overrides JointPos after AE's native update so gun animation is preserved while VR hand visuals take over specific joints.
nodes.norm_label: suppress native offhand viewmodel animation via squirrel jointpos

nodes.label: Include an Existing-Save Patcher in Final SS2VR Tooling
nodes.rationale: An offline patcher that defaults to writing a copy (in-place only behind --in-place with a timestamped backup) is safer than unreliable live console injection into a running save.
nodes.norm_label: include an existing-save patcher in final ss2vr tooling

nodes.label: Reconcile Phase Numbering Across Repo Docs and Google Sheet
nodes.rationale: PROJECT_PHASES.md and the Google Sheet are made canonical with expanded status values (YES/BUILT/EXPLORING/NO) so drifted parallel edits stop diluting progress tracking.
nodes.norm_label: reconcile phase numbering across repo docs and google sheet

nodes.label: Stage Manual Reloads, Holsters, and World Physics as Squirrel/OpenXR Design Tracks
nodes.rationale: Reloads/holsters dispatch native KEX commands and physics starts log-only/whitelisted, since KEX already owns weapon/ammo state and Dark objects can be mission-critical or invisible.
nodes.norm_label: stage manual reloads, holsters, and world physics as squirrel/openxr design tracks

nodes.label: Add Two-Handed Long Weapon Handling as a Tracked Design Path
nodes.rationale: A primary-right-hand plus secondary-left-support constraint model, staged log-only then pose-only then projectile, avoids two hands independently and unstably writing weapon pose.
nodes.norm_label: add two-handed long weapon handling as a tracked design path

nodes.label: Slim CURRENT_STATE.md into a Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Because every session reads CURRENT_STATE.md first, test queues/evidence/failures/theories are moved to dedicated docs so context bloat there does not bury the active blocker.
nodes.norm_label: slim current_state.md into a dashboard

nodes.label: Reopen Latency with a Staged Recovery Ladder
nodes.rationale: Rather than reverting directly to authoritative rendering, latency work is restaged through bounded steps since earlier failures may have been contaminated by since-fixed pitch/yaw bugs.
nodes.norm_label: reopen latency with a staged recovery ladder

nodes.label: Use Old Dark Engine Source as a Contract Reference
nodes.rationale: darkengine-main is treated as a source-confirmed contract reference, not a direct AE symbol map, validating existing semantic frob, projectile redirect, and world_scale choices.
nodes.norm_label: use old dark engine source as a contract reference

nodes.label: Triage Additional Nightdive Source Dump
nodes.rationale: The secondary source dump is byte-identical to darkengine-main for key SS2 files and is used only for release-header/Dreamcast lookups when the cleaner tree does not answer the question.
nodes.norm_label: triage additional nightdive source dump

nodes.label: Split FlatAim Reticle, Projectile, Weapon, and Picker Calibration
nodes.rationale: Visible reticle sign, projectile angular compensation, weapon-follow sign, and native picker mapping are treated as four independent calibration domains so fixing one does not regress an already-tuned one.
nodes.norm_label: split flataim reticle, projectile, weapon, and picker calibration

nodes.label: Move FlatAim Pickup Selection off Native Flat-Pixel Tuning
nodes.rationale: FlatAim reuses SS2VR's semantic-selection architecture (world ray to Squirrel scan to engine frob publish-back) because piling flat-pixel offsets onto the native cursor picker was already a proven dead end.
nodes.norm_label: move flataim pickup selection off native flat-pixel tuning

nodes.label: Hide FlatAim Stock Crosshair Through KPF Asset Override
nodes.rationale: After the Win32 overlay cover rendered as a black square, the stock crosshair is instead suppressed by packaging a transparent iface/CROSSHAI.png asset override, lower risk than a native draw hook.
nodes.norm_label: hide flataim stock crosshair through kpf asset override

nodes.label: Treat Smooth-Turn Transport as Its Own KEX Accumulator Calibration
nodes.rationale: Smooth turn gets its own smooth_turn_pixels_per_degree gain plus a fixed kexMouseSign convention, fixing a proven half-rate/opposite-sign bug causing 180/720-degree reconvergence.
nodes.norm_label: treat smooth-turn transport as its own kex accumulator calibration

nodes.label: Start Floating UI Panels with OpenXR Source-Rect Crop
nodes.rationale: The first floating-panel spike reuses the existing UI swapchain cropped via XrSwapchainSubImage.imageRect and stays visual-only so panel placement cannot steal existing interaction routing.
nodes.norm_label: start floating ui panels with openxr source-rect crop

nodes.label: Use OpenXR Cylinder Layers for the First Curved HUD Spike
nodes.rationale: Native XR_KHR_composition_layer_cylinder composition is reused for curved panels instead of a custom tessellated D3D HUD, falling back to flat quad when unsupported.
nodes.norm_label: use openxr cylinder layers for the first curved hud spike

nodes.label: Treat Native Shock Overlays as the Long-Term HUD Split Source
nodes.rationale: The real dismantled HUD/inventory system should be built from the engine's own gOverlayRects table or D3D draw-call classification rather than hand-maintained screenshot percentage crops.
nodes.norm_label: treat native shock overlays as the long-term hud split source

nodes.label: Probe Weapon/Viewmodel World-Depth Occlusion Before Writing Depth State
nodes.rationale: A log-only D3D11 probe for depth clear/state transitions is added before attempting a depth-preservation patch, since RenderDoc evidence needs live runtime confirmation first.
nodes.norm_label: probe weapon/viewmodel world-depth occlusion before writing depth state

nodes.label: Restore FlatAim's Native Crosshair and Make Semantic Publish-Back Capture-Only
nodes.rationale: The KPF crosshair override and topmost overlay are dropped in favor of the original crosshair, and ss2fa_hl becomes a swallowed DLL-private channel after a save-load crash traced near the hover-candidate scorer.
nodes.norm_label: restore flataim's native crosshair and make semantic publish-back capture-only

nodes.label: Gate FlatAim Config Publishing on a Live Squirrel Heartbeat
nodes.rationale: The DLL must not publish ss2fa_* traffic or suppress mouse look unless a private ss2fa_alive heartbeat proves ss2fa.nut is loaded and ticking, since a shadowed Squirrel half was silently missed.
nodes.norm_label: gate flataim config publishing on a live squirrel heartbeat

nodes.label: Save Patcher Defaults to Bottom/List-Last Insertion
nodes.rationale: The save patcher's default insertion position is flipped from first to last after live testing proved top-of-list was the opposite of the load priority needed for SS2VR's mod to actually run.
nodes.norm_label: save patcher defaults to bottom/list-last insertion

nodes.label: Additive Left-Hand Viewmodel Spike Remains Render-Proof First
nodes.rationale: The v1.15 spike only proves a second CameraObj viewmodel can render at all with a visible offset; it is not called true left-hand tracking until a real left-hand pose channel exists.
nodes.norm_label: additive left-hand viewmodel spike remains render-proof first

nodes.label: FlatAim Config-Setter Hook Is Opt-In for Crash Isolation
nodes.rationale: The KexSetConfigRaw hook is made opt-in (config_hook=0 default) to isolate it as a suspect after a save-load crash, given the heartbeat-gated build already proved stale publishing.
nodes.norm_label: flataim config-setter hook is opt-in for crash isolation

nodes.label: FlatAim Blocks F5 When the Squirrel Bridge Is Absent
nodes.rationale: F5 free-aim is fail-closed unless the ss2fa_alive heartbeat is fresh, since Ghidra proved the crash RVA was a native cursor-mode helper unrelated to the FlatAim config hook.
nodes.norm_label: flataim blocks f5 when the squirrel bridge is absent

nodes.label: Use Clean Post-Debug-View Saves for FlatAim Functional Tests
nodes.rationale: The old Flataim save is treated as contaminated (possibly created during debug view) and a freshly created, debug-view-free save becomes the baseline for further testing.
nodes.norm_label: use clean post-debug-view saves for flataim functional tests

nodes.label: Restore FlatAim Bridge for Clean-Save Testing
nodes.rationale: config_hook is re-enabled on the clean save baseline since the clean save loaded successfully, weakening the theory that the DLL config bridge itself crashes save-load.
nodes.norm_label: restore flataim bridge for clean-save testing

nodes.label: Patch the Correct FlatAim Save with FlatAim Last in KEX Load List
nodes.rationale: Live condump proved the save-patcher's displayed order was reversed relative to KEX's actual Mods to load list, so the correct save was re-identified and FlatAim needed to be list-last in the patcher.
nodes.norm_label: patch the correct flataim save with flataim last in kex load list

nodes.label: Revert FlatAim to Above-sshock2ee Convention and Remove Requirements Metadata
nodes.rationale: The FlatAim-after-sshock2ee ordering assumption is rejected after live condump still showed no [SS2FA] load, reverting to the earlier working above-sshock2ee order and dropping requirements metadata.
nodes.norm_label: revert flataim to above-sshock2ee convention and remove requirements metadata

nodes.label: Package FlatAim KPF as ZIP/PK so KEX Mounts kpf:/mods/flataim/
nodes.rationale: The FlatAim KPF is repacked as a proper ZIP/PK archive after discovering the installed archive began with raw sq_scripts bytes instead of a PK header, so KEX's kpf:/mods/flataim/ path never resolved.
nodes.norm_label: package flataim kpf as zip/pk so kex mounts kpf:/mods/flataim/

nodes.label: Try Native Cursor Globals Before Returning to Synthetic FlatAim Reticles
nodes.rationale: With the Squirrel bridge confirmed live, the least-invasive next step to move the visible original crosshair is writing FlatAim's pixel into KEX's native cursor globals rather than re-enabling the topmost overlay.
nodes.norm_label: try native cursor globals before returning to synthetic flataim reticles

nodes.label: Keep Weapon CameraObj Yaw/Pitch Controller-Local; Apply HMD Roll Only
nodes.rationale: Full HMD-rotation compensation on the visible weapon CameraObj is reverted because it dragged the gun with head movement; only HMD roll correction is retained with increased smoothing.
nodes.norm_label: keep weapon cameraobj yaw/pitch controller-local; apply hmd roll only

nodes.label: Principle: New Bridges Default Log-Only or Fail-Closed Until Proven Live
nodes.rationale: Across reload/holster physics, viewmodel probes, and FlatAim's Squirrel bridge, new interaction systems start default-off/log-only or refuse to activate until a live heartbeat or render proof confirms the other half is actually running.
nodes.norm_label: principle: new bridges default log-only or fail-closed until proven live

nodes.label: Principle: Reuse Engine/KEX-Owned State Instead of Reimplementing Game Logic
nodes.rationale: Manual reloads, holsters, offhand animation suppression, and FlatAim selection all route through existing KEX/AE-owned commands or Squirrel semantic scanning rather than re-deriving weapon/ammo/pick logic in the mod.
nodes.norm_label: principle: reuse engine/kex-owned state instead of reimplementing game logic

nodes.label: Principle: Keep Each Doc Scoped to Its Purpose to Protect Context Budget
nodes.rationale: Because always-read docs like CURRENT_STATE.md and the phase tracker are loaded into every session, content is routed to the doc matching its purpose instead of duplicating it inline.
nodes.norm_label: principle: keep each doc scoped to its purpose to protect context budget

nodes.label: FlatAim Load-Order Fix: Restore save-0.sav Order, Drop sshock2ee Requirement
nodes.rationale: Restored save-0.sav so FlatAim's KPF loads after sshock2ee and dropped its requirements=["sshock2ee"] dependency, reversing an earlier bottom-last assumption. The change matched the last known-good manual test instruction and removed a possible AE dependency-load blocker.
nodes.norm_label: flataim load-order fix: restore save-0.sav order, drop sshock2ee requirement

nodes.label: Try Native Cursor Globals for FlatAim Crosshair
nodes.rationale: With the Squirrel bridge proven live, tried writing the FlatAim reticle position into KEX's native cursor globals as the least-invasive way to move the original crosshair, keeping the topmost Win32 overlay disabled by default. This was a diagnostic probe, not yet a confirmed fix.
nodes.norm_label: try native cursor globals for flataim crosshair

nodes.label: Keep Weapon CameraObj Controller-Local, HMD Roll Only
nodes.rationale: Stopped converting the visible weapon CameraObj through HMD app/body rotation after it caused the gun to drag with head yaw; kept the model controller-local and applied only HMD roll correction. Accepted a small increase in visible-model smoothing for weapon weight.
nodes.norm_label: keep weapon cameraobj controller-local, hmd roll only

nodes.label: Use Funk Custom for Standalone Left-Hand Mesh Exports
nodes.rationale: Added a separate Funk Custom export path that builds a fresh single-subobject LGMD from a snapshotted Max mesh, rather than reusing the brittle legacy BSP route or emptying an animated weapon LGMD into a faux hand asset. Funk Direct/Funk Mesh remained the conservative paths for edits that must preserve original subobject/joint identity.
nodes.norm_label: use funk custom for standalone left-hand mesh exports

nodes.label: Broaden Viewmodel/World-Depth Probe Before Depth-Write Spike
nodes.rationale: Kept viewmodel/world-depth work log-only and added tracking of the UAV-capable OMSetRenderTargetsAndUnorderedAccessViews path, because the initial clear hook fired but scene-depth remember state stayed empty. Required pointer-match proof rather than same-size/same-format guesses before any future behavioral write.
nodes.norm_label: broaden viewmodel/world-depth probe before depth-write spike

nodes.label: Viewmodel/World-Depth Runtime Seam Confirmed
nodes.rationale: Runtime logs proved the exact depth seam across two captures: KEX clears the remembered world-depth DSV at a fixed draw index, and the viewmodel draw cluster begins immediately after. This unlocked moving from log-only classification to a guarded visual depth-preservation spike.
nodes.norm_label: viewmodel/world-depth runtime seam confirmed

nodes.label: Build Default-Off Viewmodel/World-Depth Visual Spike
nodes.rationale: Added the first behavioral viewmodel/world-depth test gated behind viewmodel_depth_visual_spike=false, preserving remembered world depth only for pointer-matched clears and restoring native RT/DSV state after each draw. Explicitly not to ship as a baseline feature until headset testing ruled out weapon disappearance or postprocess corruption.
nodes.norm_label: build default-off viewmodel/world-depth visual spike

nodes.label: Expand Funk Custom Toward General LGMD Object Support
nodes.rationale: Expanded Funk Custom into a general fresh-asset LGMD path supporting multiple mesh subobjects, editable vhot helpers, rebuilt material names, and one-click KPF packaging, while keeping Funk Direct/Funk Mesh untouched for weapon edits. LGMM/.CAL skinned-skeleton work was deliberately deferred to a later tier.
nodes.norm_label: expand funk custom toward general lgmd object support

nodes.label: Treat First ss2vr_lh Tint as Material/Shader Issue
nodes.rationale: Treated the transparent/bluish look of the first custom left-hand export as a material/shader issue rather than a material-ID mapping bug, since parser inspection showed correct resolution to ND-arm.psd via the viewmodel invis/fill/rim material chain. The next planned test was a deliberate opaque material override, not a material-index change.
nodes.norm_label: treat first ss2vr_lh tint as material/shader issue

nodes.label: Stop Using Cursor Globals for FlatAim's Visible Crosshair
nodes.rationale: Rejected KEX cursor globals as the visible-crosshair driver after v0.4 proved writes/readback moved but the on-screen crosshair stayed centered; re-confirmed rejection of the topmost Win32 overlay and opaque-cover paths. Future crosshair movement was redirected toward native Shock overlay/draw ownership.
nodes.norm_label: stop using cursor globals for flataim's visible crosshair

nodes.label: Draw FlatAim's Moving Crosshair Through ShockOverlay
nodes.rationale: Chose to draw FlatAim's moving crosshair through the native Squirrel/AE HUD path (ShockOverlay.DrawBitmap of the stock crosshai bitmap) instead of a new OS/D3D hook, based on a user-identified draw EID and old Shock source confirming overlay-22 ownership. Expected to compose better with game UI/menus than the rejected topmost overlay.
nodes.norm_label: draw flataim's moving crosshair through shockoverlay

nodes.label: Import SS2VR Lessons into FlatAim Local Docs
nodes.rationale: Created flataim/docs/SS2VR_FINDINGS.md to import SS2VR's semantic selection, deferred projectile redirect, CameraObj domain split, Shock overlay crosshair, and ZIP/PK packaging lessons into FlatAim, since the sidequest kept re-hitting failure families the mainline project had already characterized.
nodes.norm_label: import ss2vr lessons into flataim local docs

nodes.label: Give FlatAim Its Own Local Memory Pack
nodes.rationale: Gave FlatAim its own local memory pack (CURRENT_STATE.md, FAILURE_REGISTRY.md, implementation map) under flataim/docs/ instead of relying on the large cross-project SS2VR logs, because flataim/README.md had grown stale and easy to misuse as current truth.
nodes.norm_label: give flataim its own local memory pack

nodes.label: Depth-Limit Interaction Beam from Selected-Object Marker
nodes.rationale: Added the first interaction-beam depth stop using UI hit distance then the selected-object marker/depth, deliberately avoiding a generic world/BSP wall raycast gate because broad collision hits had previously risked re-breaking flush switch/card controls.
nodes.norm_label: depth-limit interaction beam from selected-object marker

nodes.label: Use Roomscale Capsule Clamp as First Wall-Safety Layer
nodes.rationale: Added a default-off horizontal roomscale HMD clamp (wall_safety_enabled) limiting only x/z RenderView translation, treating it as a reversible comfort spike rather than a full wall-polygon solver, since KEX collision owns the body but injected 6DOF can visually push the head through walls.
nodes.norm_label: use roomscale capsule clamp as first wall-safety layer

nodes.label: Treat Pose-Bridge KISS as Staged Validation, Not Immediate Rewrite
nodes.rationale: Chose to validate the cheap live/config hypothesis (disabling model_pose_compensate_hmd_rotation) before committing to a full Option-B pose-bridge rewrite, keeping right-hand projectile/world aim raw and separate from visible CameraObj cleanup pending that test's result.
nodes.norm_label: treat pose-bridge kiss as staged validation, not immediate rewrite

nodes.label: Prove Native Shock HUD Layout Ownership with Guarded Rect-Write Spike
nodes.rationale: Added a default-off, INI-gated spike that rewrites the native gOverlayRects[50] layout table only after validating the confirmed gOverlayOrder[50] signature, to prove layout ownership before investing in a final floating-panel VR HUD architecture.
nodes.norm_label: prove native shock hud layout ownership with guarded rect-write spike

nodes.label: Clear FlatAim Aim State on Startup Before Trusting Reticle Position
nodes.rationale: Treated ss2fa_aim as stale unless both DLL and Squirrel explicitly clear/republish it after load, because stale valid state surviving a save/load was a more likely explanation for post-load crosshair offset than a regression in the reticle draw math.
nodes.norm_label: clear flataim aim state on startup before trusting reticle position

nodes.label: Keep Selected-Object Beam Clipping Separate from Wall/Floor Depth Clipping
nodes.rationale: Confirmed pointer_depth_clip is validated only for selected/frobbable object markers and explicitly refused to stretch it into a wall/floor/window/table solution, keeping arbitrary-geometry clipping as a separate future layer using preserved world depth or native collision.
nodes.norm_label: keep selected-object beam clipping separate from wall/floor depth clipping

nodes.label: Do Not Capture Native Overlay Rect Originals from a Zero Table
nodes.rationale: Required validating usable kOverlayInv/kOverlayAmmo/kOverlayMeters anchor rects before capturing the original gOverlayRects table, after an early capture from an all-zero table collapsed the HUD to the top-left corner.
nodes.norm_label: do not capture native overlay rect originals from a zero table

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.11 Exposes Semantic Target and Clears Stale Native Hover
nodes.rationale: Treated ss2fa_hl=0 and staleness as explicit native-target clears rather than no-ops after finding the DLL only ever wrote positive semantic targets into native hover/frob globals; added a projected debug marker to compare visible reticle, semantic target, and native inspector state.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.11 exposes semantic target and clears stale native hover

nodes.label: FlatAim Selection Should Be Screen-Projected Semantic Scoring
nodes.rationale: Made screen-projected semantic scoring (distance from WorldToScreen position to the drawn reticle) FlatAim's default object-selection basis after the world-ray cylinder selector picked objects far from the crosshair depending on approach angle; kept the old selector only as an A/B diagnostic.
nodes.norm_label: flataim selection should be screen-projected semantic scoring

nodes.label: Stabilize Squirrel Highlight Targets Before VR Bracket Rendering
nodes.rationale: Kept the C++ rule that VR brackets consume only Squirrel's ss2vr_hl target (never falling back to KEX's raw objectUnderCursor), and added a Squirrel-side target-quality/noise/latch filter after logs showed ss2vr_hl itself flickering across noisy and helper-like objects.
nodes.norm_label: stabilize squirrel highlight targets before vr bracket rendering

nodes.label: Rect-Rearrange Spike Should Transform All Usable Overlay Rects by Band
nodes.rationale: Changed the HUD rect-rearrange proof to transform every usable gOverlayRects entry by vertical band instead of moving only a few named panels, after testing showed late AE-era buttons/icons went missing or out of sync when only Inv/Ammo/Meters were moved.
nodes.norm_label: rect-rearrange spike should transform all usable overlay rects by band

nodes.label: Item Physics Moves Only Through a Left-Grip, Whitelist-Gated Lane
nodes.rationale: Shipped the first moving-object physics build as default-off and Squirrel-gated behind a whitelist (helper/CameraObj rejection, BlockFrob rejection, size cap, allow-list) on a separate left-grip lane from the left-trigger frob lane, since a Stage 0 logger proved 'has physics' alone was not a safe movement permission for large objects like tables.
nodes.norm_label: item physics moves only through a left-grip, whitelist-gated lane

nodes.label: FlatAim Bracket Visuals Split Native-Looking Feedback from True Native Handoff
nodes.rationale: Split native-looking bracket feedback (stock BRACK0-3 bitmaps drawn by FlatAim) from true native bracket handoff, which was left unsolved pending an observational, INI-revertible probe of the FUN_1404b9a80 detour that must call through unchanged while disabled.
nodes.norm_label: flataim bracket visuals split native-looking feedback from true native handoff

nodes.label: Fine-Tooth Cleanup Checkpoint and Quiet Baseline
nodes.rationale: Tagged a git checkpoint and backed up the live INI before removing two documented dead-end paths (native-stereo byte forcing, snap/direct-yaw writer) from live code, keeping all confirmed working routes quiet by default and adding MkDocs as the project's browsable docs spine.
nodes.norm_label: fine-tooth cleanup checkpoint and quiet baseline

nodes.label: Pose-Loss Viewmodel Fallback and Black Menu Background
nodes.rationale: On tracking loss, stopped writing SS2VR CameraObj overrides so the native Nightdive handler resumes the standard viewmodel pose, and hid/destroyed the additive left-hand model, after users reported weapons/hands sticking inside the HMD when the old Squirrel fallback kept stale VR offsets.
nodes.norm_label: pose-loss viewmodel fallback and black menu background

nodes.label: Keep Current State as a Dashboard, Move Build History Out
nodes.rationale: Narrowed CURRENT_STATE.md to only the active baseline/build/next-tests dashboard and moved release hashes and older handoff notes into BUILD_HISTORY.md, because the always-read entry point had accumulated the same long history that belonged in domain docs and the decision log.
nodes.norm_label: keep current state as a dashboard, move build history out

nodes.label: Add Preserved-Subobject Hand Extraction Before More Fresh Hand Recompiles
nodes.rationale: Added a Funk Extract path that isolates and preserves the known-good pistol hand's source material/UV/light/normal/face records and BSP slice instead of regenerating them, after comparing the known-good hand (265 faces/186 lights) against a fresh Funk Custom export (358 faces/1074 light records) as a cleaner test of the blue/translucent tint cause.
nodes.norm_label: add preserved-subobject hand extraction before more fresh hand recompiles

nodes.label: Lock Pose Bridge Fixes Behind Paired DLL/Squirrel Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Stopped tuning the weapon/hand pose bridge by headset appearance alone and required paired DLL (pose_diag_right/left) and Squirrel ([SS2VR-POSE]) diagnostics so a bug could be localized to C++ publication, Squirrel consumption, or AE rendering, using the left-hand viewmodel as a parity check.
nodes.norm_label: lock pose bridge fixes behind paired dll/squirrel diagnostics

nodes.label: FlatAim Visible Weapon Uses Screen-Local Mode-4 Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Stopped treating weapon_follow_mode=3 as a fix for pitch-look causing weapon roll and added mode 4, a screen-local diagnostic canceling KEX's pitched CameraObj basis via Heading=rawHeading/safeCos and pitch-aware Bank compensation.
nodes.norm_label: flataim visible weapon uses screen-local mode-4 diagnostic

nodes.label: FlatAim Mode Numbers Must Pass C++ Clamp and Squirrel Proof
nodes.rationale: Established that any new FlatAim numeric follow-mode must update the C++ LoadIni() validation clamp in the same change as the Squirrel implementation, after a stale 1..3 clamp silently reset a staged mode 4 back to mode 1, invalidating a full round of roll testing.
nodes.norm_label: flataim mode numbers must pass c++ clamp and squirrel proof

nodes.label: Retire FlatAim Inverse-Cos Bank Cancellation
nodes.rationale: Retired the inverse-cos Heading boost plus Bank cancellation as the mode-4 solution after it produced a >360-degree gun roll and pitch inversion near vertical camera pitch, replacing it with a bounded hybrid that fades Heading near vertical and uses lateral CameraObj.Offset instead.
nodes.norm_label: retire flataim inverse-cos bank cancellation

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.17 Uses Bounded Anti-Roll, Not Inverse-Cos
nodes.rationale: Added Bank cancellation derived only from the already-faded v0.16 Heading term (no cos-division) to address remaining mid-pitch roll that the bounded hybrid alone did not fully remove, without reintroducing the v0.15 singularity.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.17 uses bounded anti-roll, not inverse-cos

nodes.label: FlatAim Visible Weapon Pivots to Rig-Level aimPoint
nodes.rationale: Stopped treating final CameraObj Heading/Pitch/Bank tuning as the main fix after bounded Bank cancellation showed no meaningful improvement, moving to mode 5: inserting FlatAim yaw/pitch at the native viewmodel rig's aimPoint before the stock gunPoint-to-CameraObj write runs.
nodes.norm_label: flataim visible weapon pivots to rig-level aimpoint

nodes.label: FlatAim Stops Treating Rig-Level aimPoint as the Roll Fix
nodes.rationale: Falsified rig-level aimPoint insertion (mode 5) after logs proved it ran but roll/slide symptoms persisted, and source review showed ND.PointRig only linearly adds Euler channels; moved to mode 6, a bounded screen-axis Heading/Bank decomposition with rotation locks off.
nodes.norm_label: flataim stops treating rig-level aimpoint as the roll fix

nodes.label: Separate Tracked and Fallback Weapon Viewmodel Scale
nodes.rationale: Split the single ss2vr_weapon_scale into separate tracked and fallback scale values after the native-KEX-frame remap made the old 0.65 value feel too small while tracked but far too large in native fallback pose, since apparent scale became pose-mode dependent.
nodes.norm_label: separate tracked and fallback weapon viewmodel scale

nodes.label: FlatAim Exits Final CameraObj Euler Tuning for the Weapon-Roll Test
nodes.rationale: Abandoned final CameraObj Euler-channel tuning entirely after mode-6 variant 0 still routed near-vertical horizontal aim into Bank, moving to mode 7: hiding the native CameraObj weapon while F5 is active and driving a transient world-space proxy weapon along the FlatAim ray instead.
nodes.norm_label: flataim exits final cameraobj euler tuning for the weapon-roll test

nodes.label: FlatAim World Proxy Uses Object.Teleport Facing Order
nodes.rationale: Determined world-object Object.Teleport/Position facing order is (roll, pitch, yaw), not CameraObj's Heading/Pitch/Bank, after the mode-7 proxy showed yaw fixed to world north; replaced unreliable CameraObj Draw?=false hiding with reversible tiny-scale hiding, confirmed via Nightdive's PointRig.GetPhysicsVector() convention.
nodes.norm_label: flataim world proxy uses object.teleport facing order

nodes.label: CameraObj Native-Frame Remap Is Orientation-Only
nodes.rationale: Applied the native pre-override KEX camera frame remap to visible CameraObj orientation only, not translation, after using it for translation caused apparent scale/depth errors (early table clipping, undersized models) even though it had fixed HMD yaw/roll bleed in orientation.
nodes.norm_label: cameraobj native-frame remap is orientation-only

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.22 Proxy Uses Screen-Up Look-At as Diagnostic Default
nodes.rationale: Kept mode 7 active but replaced the plain (roll,pitch,yaw) proxy comparator with facing mode 4: aiming the proxy at a target on the FlatAim ray and deriving Roll from camera/screen-up, after plain channel-swap testing still turned pitched horizontal aim into roll.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.22 proxy uses screen-up look-at as diagnostic default

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.23 Treats Screen-Up Proxy Roll Sign as Unproven
nodes.rationale: Accepted that scalar Heading/Bank redistribution was the wrong family of fix for the native CameraObj path, kept the world-proxy approach, but treated v0.22's screen-up Roll sign as unproven and added a signed A/B test plus rollRaw/rollApplied/rollSign logging after users still saw roll while aimed up/down.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.23 treats screen-up proxy roll sign as unproven

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.24 Tests Proxy-Origin Look-At with Zero Dynamic Roll
nodes.rationale: Treated the dynamic screen-up Roll term itself as suspect and added facing mode 5: proxy-origin look-at direction combined with world-object (bank, pitch, heading) and zero per-frame Roll solve, isolating whether the look-at geometry or the dynamic Roll computation was the remaining problem.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.24 tests proxy-origin look-at with zero dynamic roll

nodes.label: Snap-Turn v2 Uses Accumulator/Body Transport Plus Immediate Display Yaw Step
nodes.rationale: Reintroduced snap turn on top of KEX's normal mouse-accumulator body transport rather than reviving previously-rejected direct/absolute-angle writers, updating the cached HMD-authoritative display baseline immediately by an expected yaw delta and suppressing post-snap HMD deltas for 180ms to avoid stacking head motion into the snap.
nodes.norm_label: snap-turn v2 uses accumulator/body transport plus immediate display yaw step

nodes.label: Default-Off Gating for Behavioral/Safety Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Recurring rule across the depth-visual spike, HUD rect-rearrange spike, phys-grab lane, and wall-safety clamp: ship a new behavioral or safety-affecting change first as an INI-gated, default-off diagnostic with an explicit success/failure log gate, not as a baseline feature.
nodes.norm_label: default-off gating for behavioral/safety diagnostics

nodes.label: Scalar CameraObj Euler Tuning Rejected as a Fix Family
nodes.rationale: After FlatAim modes 3 through 6 all failed to fix pitch-driven weapon roll, concluded that scalar tuning of final CameraObj Heading/Pitch/Bank/Euler channels is not the right fix family for pitch-invariant screen-local weapon aim. Further work moved to a different representation (rig-level, then world-space proxy) instead of sign-flipping more scalars.
nodes.norm_label: scalar cameraobj euler tuning rejected as a fix family

nodes.label: Keep Interaction/Rendering Domains From Bleeding Into Each Other
nodes.rationale: Recurring convention: keep distinct domains separate — selected-object beam clipping vs. wall/floor depth clipping, physical grab vs. frob interaction, visible CameraObj orientation vs. translation/aim — rather than solving one problem by overloading another domain's data path.
nodes.norm_label: keep interaction/rendering domains from bleeding into each other

nodes.label: CameraObj Native-Frame Remap Is Orientation-Only
nodes.rationale: Applying the native pre-override KEX camera frame to visible-weapon orientation fixed HMD yaw/roll bleed, but applying it to translation broke apparent scale/depth (clipping, undersized meshes). Translation stays on the older HMD-compensated path until a dedicated probe proves a better frame.
nodes.norm_label: cameraobj native-frame remap is orientation-only

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.22 Proxy Uses Screen-Up Look-At as Diagnostic Default
nodes.rationale: v0.21 proved plain (roll,pitch,yaw) turned pitched aim into roll and mirrored the horizon, so v0.22 aims from the proxy's world position and derives Roll from camera/screen up. This is the first diagnostic default to give the proxy an explicit roll reference.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.22 proxy uses screen-up look-at as diagnostic default

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.23 Treats Screen-Up Proxy Roll Sign as Unproven
nodes.rationale: v0.22 loaded and ran but the user still saw roll while aimed up/down, so v0.23 flips weapon_proxy_roll_sign to -1.0 as a small diagnostic rather than reverting to native CameraObj scalar variants. Proxy pose logging (rollRaw/rollApplied/rollSign) is added to make the sign question falsifiable.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.23 treats screen-up proxy roll sign as unproven

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.24 Tests Proxy-Origin Look-At With Zero Dynamic Roll
nodes.rationale: Sign-flipping a large dynamic Roll term was recognized as another scalar workaround, so v0.24 adds facing_mode=5: proxy-origin look-at with no per-frame Roll solve at all, isolating whether dynamic Roll itself is the problem.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.24 tests proxy-origin look-at with zero dynamic roll

nodes.label: Gate Route-B Menu Pointer on Native Menu Draw Frames
nodes.rationale: Route-B's cursor-warp fired during gameplay/weapon tests because RmlUi menus aren't represented by gameUiActive_, so the fix gates OS-cursor warp/click on the D3D frame classifier reporting menuDraws>0 rather than adding a new RmlUi hook.
nodes.norm_label: gate route-b menu pointer on native menu draw frames

nodes.label: Snap Turns Get a Compositor Black-Frame Comfort Layer
nodes.rationale: A dedicated final OpenXR quad layer renders black for snap_turn_blackout_ms after snap v2 commits, kept separate from vr_effects and the scene copy so it doesn't disturb other tests. It is reversible via config and avoids clearing/corrupting the underlying game frame while hiding a remaining one-frame visual discontinuity.
nodes.norm_label: snap turns get a compositor black-frame comfort layer

nodes.label: Pistol Muzzle Flash Follows via Flash-Object CameraObj, Not Projectile Retuning
nodes.rationale: AE source shows NDViewmodelBase.SpawnMuzzleFlash() creates a separate flash object with its own CameraObj, so the fix attaches an SS2VR script to the flash archetype and writes its CameraObj from controller pose. The already-confirmed deferred projectile redirect and aim signs are left untouched to avoid mixing visual polish with functional shot direction.
nodes.norm_label: pistol muzzle flash follows via flash-object cameraobj, not projectile retuning

nodes.label: First Real Game-Event FX Binding Uses Squirrel HitPoints Polling
nodes.rationale: A Squirrel-side player HitPoints watcher routes through the already-proven ss2vr_fx config-setter bridge, avoiding a new reverse-engineered damage RVA or a second visual-effects path. The same ss2vr_fx event path is intended to later carry comms/poison triggers too.
nodes.norm_label: first real game-event fx binding uses squirrel hitpoints polling

nodes.label: Keep Active Docs Lean; Archive Settled and Sidequest Trails
nodes.rationale: CURRENT_STATE.md and HYPOTHESES.md had started acting like chat history, making future agents reread stale or disproven work as current; settled foundations and sidequest trails move to their _ARCHIVE.md counterparts. The Excel tracker is synced from PROJECT_PHASES.md using a weighted status model (YES=100%, BUILT=75%, EXPLORING=35%, NO=0%).
nodes.norm_label: keep active docs lean; archive settled and sidequest trails

nodes.label: Right-Arm Ammo HUD Should Be a Separate Cropped Quad, Not the Old Hand-Panel Slot
nodes.rationale: A default-off right_arm_hud_* path submits a second cropped OpenXR quad near the right controller using a hardcoded percentage screenshot slice as a fast scaffold, explicitly marked temporary until native overlay-rect crops replace it.
nodes.norm_label: right-arm ammo hud should be a separate cropped quad, not the old hand-panel slot

nodes.label: Right-Arm Ammo HUD Should Use Native Overlay Rects by Default
nodes.rationale: User testing proved the percentage slice unstable because inventory mode expands that HUD region and pulls in unrelated data, so the crop source defaults to native_rect, cropping the engine's own ammo overlay rect guarded by the known gOverlayOrder signature. The slice path is preserved only as a diagnostic fallback.
nodes.norm_label: right-arm ammo hud should use native overlay rects by default

nodes.label: Expand Phase 5.8.1 Digital Glitch Modes Through the Existing GPU Effect Manager
nodes.rationale: datamosh, mosaic/deres, and depthglitch are added to the already-confirmed D3D11 post-process path with the same ss2vr_fx trigger surface; datamosh uses per-eye-local frame history to avoid cross-eye smear discomfort. Wiring a true shader-readable scene-depth SRV is deliberately deferred to a separate 5.8.2 task rather than bundled in.
nodes.norm_label: expand phase 5.8.1 digital glitch modes through the existing gpu effect manager

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.25 Tests Captured Screen-Up Basis Before Roll-to-Offset Remap
nodes.rationale: v0.24 proved removing explicit Roll alone doesn't remove visible roll, so facing_mode=6 captures a flat-screen right/up basis from Camera.GetFacing() at mode entry and solves proxy-origin look-at against it, deferring roll-to-offset remapping which resembled the old slidey-weapon failure mode.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.25 tests captured screen-up basis before roll-to-offset remap

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.26 Hard-Kills Proxy Roll Before Quaternion/Model-Axis Work
nodes.rationale: v0.25's captured Camera.GetFacing() baseline generated huge rollApplied values near pitched views, so v0.26 forces world-object Roll to 0.0 every frame to cleanly fork the diagnosis: if visible roll stops, tune static offsets; if it persists, the roll is downstream of FlatAim's explicit Roll channel.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.26 hard-kills proxy roll before quaternion/model-axis work

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.27 Treats Visible Roll as Downstream of Explicit Roll
nodes.rationale: v0.26 logs proved facing.x=0.00/rollApplied=0.00/rollKill=1 while the user still saw roll, ruling out a nonzero Roll scalar as the cause. v0.27 stops tuning Roll signs and instead adds a proxy-only heading mirror plus intended-basis (basisF/basisR/basisU) diagnostics to compare intended basis against rendered mesh behavior.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.27 treats visible roll as downstream of explicit roll

nodes.label: FlatAim v0.28 Adopts Dark Matrix Heading Convention for Proxy Facing
nodes.rationale: Dark source's mx_mat2rad reads heading as atan2(forward.y, forward.x) while FlatAim's proxy used atan2(dir.x, dir.y) -- a swapped convention that better explains 'horizon works, pitch grows into roll' than more sign tuning. facing_mode=8 builds an upright basis and extracts Dark (bank,pitch,heading) from it directly.
nodes.norm_label: flataim v0.28 adopts dark matrix heading convention for proxy facing

nodes.label: Detect Radiation/Toxin Through Squirrel Properties and Draw a VR Hazard Meter
nodes.rationale: Native RadLevel/RadAmb/Toxin properties are polled read-only from Squirrel and published through the existing config-setter bridge as ss2vr_hazard, driving a small OpenXR RAD/TOX meter and reusing the GPU effect manager for pulses (depthglitch, aberration) without hooking native hazard code or the flat HUD.
nodes.norm_label: detect radiation/toxin through squirrel properties and draw a vr hazard meter

nodes.label: v1.42 Restores Inventory Visibility and Makes Controller Fallback Explicit
nodes.rationale: User testing showed the right-arm HUD spike blanked inventory, left-stick movement wasn't moving the player, controller-held weapons were still HMD-tugged, and gravity-glove objects used the wrong rotation basis; the fix forces the full UI quad on during UI/cursor mode, allows keyboard movement fallback until KEX-native held-axis is proven, defaults weapon HMD compensation off, and defaults gravity-glove facing to Dark/AE (bank,pitch,heading).
nodes.norm_label: v1.42 restores inventory visibility and makes controller fallback explicit

nodes.label: Current Test Run Uses Quiet Logs With Only Active Diagnostics Enabled
nodes.rationale: The prior test set was blocked by inventory disappearance, left-stick failure, and HMD/viewmodel bleed, and logging everything at once made logs harder to interpret; solved/background probes are turned off in the live INI, keeping only native_movement_log and model_pose_diagnostic on so the next headset pass stays falsifiable.
nodes.norm_label: current test run uses quiet logs with only active diagnostics enabled

nodes.label: FlatAim Proves View-Frame Aim and Native-Velocity Projectile Anchoring
nodes.rationale: Free-aim offsets are treated as view-frame tangent offsets (normalize(forward + tan(dx)*right + tan(dy)*up)) rather than added directly to world heading/pitch, which had pinched near pitch poles and turned horizontal aim into roll. Deferred native projectile velocity is preserved as the true forward basis and the view-frame offset is applied around it, with both facing and velocity written for coherent gameplay state.
nodes.norm_label: flataim proves view-frame aim and native-velocity projectile anchoring

nodes.label: Right-Hand Projectile Aim Defaults On Through Squirrel
nodes.rationale: With the Squirrel deferred projectile redirect repeatedly confirmed as the working shot carrier, SS2VRWeaponAimEnabled() now treats a missing ss2vr_weapon_aim as 1, while the old DLL trace/launch rewrite path stays disabled as a dead-end.
nodes.norm_label: right-hand projectile aim defaults on through squirrel

nodes.label: FlatAim Broad-Weapon Fixes Stay Domain-Specific
nodes.rationale: With pistol aim/projectiles/muzzle flash working, later weapon symptoms are fixed in their own domain rather than reusing the pistol's fix: laser sideways bolts via projectile object-facing mode, long-gun butt intrusion via proxy pivot, and Wrench treated as a likely melee-viewmodel-path issue until logs prove otherwise.
nodes.norm_label: flataim broad-weapon fixes stay domain-specific

nodes.label: FlatAim Rendered-Object Frame Beats Stored/View Basis for World Attachments
nodes.rationale: World-space proxy pivot and effect placement must use the rendered object frame from SS2FA_FacingBasis(facing); stored proxyBasis/view-frame bases are for solving aim only, not for placing world attachments. The laser bolt and shotgun pivot bugs shared this root: new features had been consuming reflected view/native-launch bases as if they were rendered object bases.
nodes.norm_label: flataim rendered-object frame beats stored/view basis for world attachments

nodes.label: FlatAim Wrench/Melee Follows the Melee Viewmodel Route
nodes.rationale: Melee is implemented by patching NDShockMeleeViewmodel rather than extending the gun ModelName proxy route, letting the native melee update run first and then writing PlyrArm from the solved FlatAim view-frame aim, since true hand-bone IK is outside Squirrel's capability.
nodes.norm_label: flataim wrench/melee follows the melee viewmodel route

nodes.label: FlatAim Wrench/PlyrArm Uses Native-Relative Crossed Orientation
nodes.rationale: Superseded the same week: orientation_mode=3 applied FlatAim dyaw to native heading and dpitch to native bank on top of the neutral native PlyrArm pose, but it caused visible spin/orbit and was replaced by a location-only default.
nodes.norm_label: flataim wrench/plyrarm uses native-relative crossed orientation

nodes.label: FlatAim Default Melee Preserves Native Orientation
nodes.rationale: User confirmed the Wrench stayed visible but spun/orbited on left/right aim, and native NDShockMeleeViewmodel only writes PlyrArm Location -- so orientation_mode=3 becomes location-only (writeFacing=0), with FlatAim's added Heading/Pitch/Bank writes identified as the non-native spin trigger.
nodes.norm_label: flataim default melee preserves native orientation

nodes.label: FlatAim Melee Offsets Use Native ND.Point Local Axes
nodes.rationale: Location-only melee made the Wrench usable enough to diagnose a pure axis issue: left/right reticle motion moved the Wrench forward/back because gun-proxy local Y differs from melee local Y. The fix uses native ND.Point local axes (local X depth, Y lateral, Z vertical) instead of gun proxy axes, keeping writeFacing=0.
nodes.norm_label: flataim melee offsets use native nd.point local axes

nodes.label: FlatAim Edge Pan Stays on Native Mouse-Look Path
nodes.rationale: Edge-pan view follow writes synthetic native mouse accumulators inside the existing PlayerTurnTilt hook and calls native PlayerTurnTilt before publishing ss2fa_aim, avoiding direct player yaw/pitch writes while keeping the FlatAim ray, projectile redirect, and proxy weapon based on the newly panned view.
nodes.norm_label: flataim edge pan stays on native mouse-look path

nodes.label: FlatAim Pickup Reach Uses Stock 8 KEX-Unit Frob Distance
nodes.rationale: Old Shock/DeepCover source passes frobdist into PickSetFocus() as a squared max distance with fallback 64, so normal reach is sqrt(64)=8 KEX units; FlatAim's earlier 20.0 INI override of its already-correct default is reverted, with larger values kept as diagnostics only.
nodes.norm_label: flataim pickup reach uses stock 8 kex-unit frob distance

nodes.label: FlatAim Sidequest Is Player-Facing Freelook Mode
nodes.rationale: The mode is renamed 'Freelook mode' for players while internal artifact/protocol names (flataim.dll/ini, SS2FA, ss2fa_*) stay compatible; the public INI exposes only normal feel controls and locks weapon_proxy_scale/reach behind a hidden allow_cheat_tuning flag so gameplay-affecting values aren't presented as normal options.
nodes.norm_label: flataim sidequest is player-facing freelook mode

nodes.label: Standalone Funk Extract Hands Must Be Static Unless Hierarchy Is Preserved
nodes.rationale: ss2vr_lj preserved source jointed metadata (motion_type=2,joint_id=2) while making the mesh subobject 0/root, and the user's test crashed AE with an AV tied to that file; standalone hand probes must use motion_type=0,joint_id=-1 unless a future exporter builds a complete static root plus jointed child hierarchy.
nodes.norm_label: standalone funk extract hands must be static unless hierarchy is preserved

nodes.label: Treat LGMM Wrench Import as Reference, Not an LGMD Export Source
nodes.rationale: Raw LGMM import crumpled the arm and lacked textures, and joint offsets live in the .CAL, not the LGMD exporters, so LGMM/CAL becomes a visual reference-only workflow (BintoE.exe + Eto3DS.exe building direct Max geometry) while true LGMM+CAL export is deferred to a separate investigation doc.
nodes.norm_label: treat lgmm wrench import as reference, not an lgmd export source

nodes.label: Physical Reload Visuals Should Be Transient Objects, Not Live LGMD Subobject Reparenting
nodes.rationale: VR physical magazines/shells/cells are built as separate transient/additive visuals that follow hand pose and trigger native reload actions at validated gesture moments, rather than dynamically reparenting a magazine subobject inside the loaded LGMD weapon at runtime, keeping native reload/fire/ammo state owned by KEX.
nodes.norm_label: physical reload visuals should be transient objects, not live lgmd subobject reparenting

nodes.label: Treat VR Wrench as an Authored Static LGMD Viewmodel
nodes.rationale: A new complete static LGMD (wrench plus gripping hand/forearm) driven by the existing static melee carrier/CameraObj pose path is preferred over direct LGMM export or native PlyrArm retargeting, since pipewrench_h/wrench_h are LGMM+CAL skeletal meshes but the proven FunkMax pipeline is strongest for static LGMD.
nodes.norm_label: treat vr wrench as an authored static lgmd viewmodel

nodes.label: Use Readable ss2vr_ Aliases for Authored Weapon/Viewmodel BINs
nodes.rationale: New authored viewmodel BINs use ss2vr_<weapon_slug>.bin with exporter/provenance suffixes like _roundtrip_from_max stripped before packaging, making SS2VR-authored variants auditable and distinct from stock-name overrides used for drop-in equip compatibility.
nodes.norm_label: use readable ss2vr_ aliases for authored weapon/viewmodel bins

nodes.label: Keep LGPMNM Tooling Read-Only Until the Payload Is Visually/Runtime Confirmed
nodes.rationale: The first-pass LGPMNM parser confirms coherent counts and buffers but two per-vertex extra fields remain unidentified, so writing/rewriting/runtime replacement is deferred until the high-detail mesh is visually confirmed in Max; imported LGPMNM nodes are tagged non-export so LGMD exporters ignore them.
nodes.norm_label: keep lgpmnm tooling read-only until the payload is visually/runtime confirmed

nodes.label: Export Edited LGPMNM Wrench References as Fresh Static LGMD Snapshots
nodes.rationale: A dedicated LGPMNM -> LGMD path builds a fresh static snapshot rather than treating LGPMNM imports as patchable LGMD nodes, because the LGMD-preserving writers need original subobject/node/face identity that reference geometry lacks; lgpmnm_anchor_## helpers are treated as reference anchors, not vhots.
nodes.norm_label: export edited lgpmnm wrench references as fresh static lgmd snapshots

nodes.label: Runtime Safety Means Hierarchy Safety, Not Just Parse Safety
nodes.rationale: A user-exported BIN parsed cleanly but had a duplicated mesh and a subobject pointing its sibling field at itself, echoing a prior KEX LGMD-loader INT3 on parser-clean assets; the runtime-safety validator must now reject self-child/self-sibling links, out-of-range indices, and sibling cycles, and the LGPMNM exporter must de-duplicate mesh handles before building hierarchy.
nodes.norm_label: runtime safety means hierarchy safety, not just parse safety

nodes.label: Use Workflow-Oriented FunkMax Button Names
nodes.rationale: Export Exact and Funk Direct are removed from the normal rollout as implementation-history debug tools; Funk Mesh/Custom/Extract are renamed LGMD Modify Existing/Custom/Extract Subobject so button names describe user intent across the four workflow types (modify, new static, extract subobject, LGPMNM snapshot).
nodes.norm_label: use workflow-oriented funkmax button names

nodes.label: Deleted Animated Weapon Subobjects Must Be Stubbed, Not Emptied
nodes.rationale: The KEX loader can INT3 on parser-clean LGMDs that retain animated zero-face hand subobjects, so LGMD Modify Existing keeps subobject/joint identity but stubs a microscopic hidden face instead of writing true zero-face non-root subobjects. Superseded the same day after live testing showed one-face stubs and full pruning both still crashed/hung stock animated weapon overrides.
nodes.norm_label: deleted animated weapon subobjects must be stubbed, not emptied

nodes.label: Stock Animated Weapon Overrides Must Keep Expected Rig Subobject Records
nodes.rationale: v1.86-pruned-weapons parsed and validated cleanly but still crashed pistol/AR/laser live, with the AR crash dump tying failure to the game-side model-loader for the pruned stock-name override; stock-name atek_h/ar15_h/lasehand overrides are not packaged unless expected rig subobjects are preserved, with stock fallback restored until a new strategy proves safe.
nodes.norm_label: stock animated weapon overrides must keep expected rig subobject records

nodes.label: Keep CURRENT_STATE as a Dashboard, Not an Archive
nodes.rationale: CURRENT_STATE.md had become a mixed dashboard/changelog/test-queue/archive that made reloads expensive and hid the current priority; detailed build archaeology moves to BUILD_HISTORY.md and inactive notes to CURRENT_STATE_ARCHIVE.md so future agents don't inherit stale experiments as active work.
nodes.norm_label: keep current_state as a dashboard, not an archive

nodes.label: Lock Accepted v1.90 ATEK Pistol by Exact Digest
nodes.rationale: User confirmed v1.89's full-rig pistol was loader-safe but still showed the left hand, and v1.90's repaired one-face structure removes it; the runtime-safety validator allowlists only this exact atek_h.bin SHA256 for near-empty hand subobjects, explicitly not extending safety to AR or laser pistol one-face variants.
nodes.norm_label: lock accepted v1.90 atek pistol by exact digest

nodes.label: Reserve High Vhot IDs for SS2VR Weapon Metadata
nodes.rationale: Native AE vhots 0..3 stay reserved for muzzle/eject behavior while vhot_80/81/82 carry SS2VR VR-pivot/support/reload metadata without a new sidecar format. Superseded 2026-06-19 by the low-contiguous-ID rule after a high-ID AR15 candidate crashed KEX's native LGMD loader before menu.
nodes.norm_label: reserve high vhot ids for ss2vr weapon metadata

nodes.label: Add Nemyax-Parity Full-Prune Exporter as a Diagnostic Path
nodes.rationale: The original full-prune failure may have been confounded by a leaf-only node rebuild rather than subobject removal itself, so a separate LGMD Nemyax Prune TEST path fully removes emptied subobjects while rebuilding surviving hierarchy nodes in the Nemyax Blender exporter's compiler-shaped child/call/split style; runtime status remains unproven pending one-weapon-at-a-time testing.
nodes.norm_label: add nemyax-parity full-prune exporter as a diagnostic path

nodes.label: Add Static LGMD Mirror Workflow for Empty Right-Hand Candidates
nodes.rationale: A prior Max-side negative-scale/Reset-XForm mirror left viewport normals/facing ambiguous because game-side correctness depends on face winding, light refs, UV refs, and packed light normals staying coherent together; LGMD Mirror Static transforms all of those fields in one binary operation and repairs stale header count bytes at the same time.
nodes.norm_label: add static lgmd mirror workflow for empty right-hand candidates

nodes.label: Add Append-Static Path for Stock Animated Weapon Hand Meshes
nodes.rationale: LGMD Custom rebuilt shotgun internals in a crashy shape by changing the animated pump vertex range, so LGMD Append Static adds the hand as a new static child subobject with its own contiguous vertex/light/normal ranges, preserving the stock animated rig's original ranges untouched.
